quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: Both intersecting highways are two-directional: After entering the intersection, the left turn must be made so as to leave the intersection to the right of the centerline of the highway being entered.

activation.condition: Driver intends and makes a left turn at an intersection of two two-directional highways.

obligation.description: After entering the intersection, leave it to the right of the centerline of the highway being entered.

timing.description: Observe original intersection entry through completed departure on the destination highway.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Both highway status and permitted opposing directions require independently sourced map and access review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: leave the intersection to the right of the centerline of the highway being entered
judgment_calls_needed.note: The statute supplies no numeric lateral cutoff; source-bound full-body departure, destination direction and centerline require review.

parameter_refs.name: departure_lateral_position
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: two planned offsets, 1.7 m and 2.7 m, as construction targets rather than legal thresholds
